$schema_note: Canonical visual-asset registry for SkyyRose. Same authority tier as skyyrose-catalog.csv: every page layout, prototype brief, and agent dispatch that places NON-PRODUCT imagery MUST resolve through this file. Product imagery resolves through the catalog CSV (image/front_model_image/back_model_image columns). Paths relative to assets/. An asset used for a collection it is not registered to is a canon violation. status: 'verified' = founder-confirmed or canon-derived; 'needs-founder-review' = best-evidence assignment awaiting Corey's confirmation.

usage_rules: Product imagery (model shots, ghosts, flats) resolves through skyyrose-catalog.csv columns — never this file, never invented paths, never per-product subdirectory guesses.
Collection lockup images ARE the collection names. Never type-render a collection name as a hero or panel title.
Cross-collection imagery use (e.g., red roses on a Black Rose surface) is a canon violation unless this manifest registers the asset to that collection.
Black-lettering lockups (br-*) require the invert treatment or a light ground.
Filenames are NOT identity — this manifest is. If pixels contradict the registry entry, stop and flag (see the 2026-06-10 sherpa mis-file).
New imagery enters this manifest in the same commit that adds the files; status starts at needs-founder-review unless Corey assigns it.
